user.title: Better Lighting
user.description: These are the house-wide defaults. Every zone inherits them, and any zone or individual light can override them later.

data_description.interval: How often lights are re-adapted while in adaptive mode.
data_description.min_brightness_pct: Brightness at the darkest point of the day. This shapes the curve; individual lights clamp on top of it.
data_description.max_brightness_pct: Brightness at the brightest point of the day.
data_description.brightness_mode: 'Sun' holds maximum all day and ramps only at night. 'Tanh' fades smoothly around sunrise and sunset, starting before the sun is down.

data.brightness_mode_time_dark: Fade duration on the dark side
data.brightness_mode_time_light: Fade duration on the light side
data.intercept_member_calls: Intercept calls made directly to member lights

data_description.take_over_control: When someone changes a light by hand, stop adapting it until it is switched off again or the timer below expires.
data_description.separate_turn_on_commands: Some bulbs drop the colour when brightness arrives in the same command. Enable this only for those.
data_description.intercept_member_calls: Only needed if your switches are wired to the individual bulbs instead of the zone. Falls back automatically if unavailable.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Better Lighting is already set up. Add zones, scenes and controllers from its entry.

init.title: Global defaults
init.description: Changing these re-applies to every zone that has not overridden them.

user.title: Add zone
user.description: A zone is one room's lights, controlled together. Each light can belong to only one zone.

data_description.lights: The lights in this room. A light may belong to only one zone, so that manual changes and scene control are never ambiguous.

data.all: Only report on when every light is on

data_description.remember_on_state: When the zone is switched back on, light only the lights that were on when it was switched off.
data_description.brightness_strategy: How one brightness value is derived from the lights that are on.

data_description.adaptive_override_enabled: Leave off to follow the global defaults. Everything below is ignored until you turn this on.

data.night_ignore_presence: Ignore presence while in night mode

data_description.night_source_entity: An existing helper or sensor that is on when the house is asleep. This zone's night switch mirrors it.
data_description.night_ignore_presence: For bedrooms: stop a presence sensor turning the light on during the night.
data_description.night_scene_id: Used when 'What night mode does' is set to apply a scene.

data.restore_on_power_cycle: After the room is switched off

data_description.resume_max_age_minutes: So a room left off overnight starts the next morning in adaptive rather than in last night's dinner scene.

data.presence_covers: Only when these covers are closed
data.presence_on_only_when_off: Only act on a room that is off

data_description.presence_clear_delay: Occupancy sensors flicker. Waiting avoids switching a room off while somebody is still in it.
data_description.presence_covers: So the lights only come on when the blinds are down and the room is actually dark. Closing a cover while somebody is already in the room counts too.
data_description.presence_on_only_when_off: Walking into a room you already lit by hand should not restyle it.
data_description.presence_respects_manual: Switching off behind somebody who set the room by hand is the rudest possible reading of an empty room.
data_description.cover_unknown_blocks: The point of the gate is 'it is dark in here', and a cover we cannot read is not evidence of that.

data.insect_only_when_on: Only if the room is already lit
data.insect_open_delay: Wait before reacting to an open window
data.insect_close_delay: Wait before reacting to a closed window

data_description.insect_scene_id: Usually something deep amber, which attracts far fewer insects than white light.
data_description.insect_only_when_on: An open window is no reason to light a dark room.
data_description.insect_close_delay: Stops a slamming window flickering the room.

user.title: Calibrate a light
user.description: Trim one light so it matches its neighbours. Offsets are a calibration and are applied first; the minimum and maximum are an operating limit and are applied afterwards, so a calibration can never push a light past a limit you set.

data_description.brightness_offset_pct: Percentage points added to whatever the curve asks for. Use a negative value for a light that reads too bright.
data_description.color_temp_offset_k: Kelvin added to the curve's colour temperature. Negative is warmer. Applied to colour-only bulbs too.
data_description.min_brightness_pct: An absolute floor for this light, not a shift of the zone's range. A light that flickers below 15% should be set to 15.

user.title: Scene
user.description: A scene is a recipe, not a room. Define it once and apply it anywhere. Choose carefully what it takes over: whatever it leaves alone keeps following the sun.

data_description.override_mode: 'Brightness' pins the brightness and lets the colour keep tracking the sun. 'Colour' does the opposite. 'Both' fixes the look entirely. 'Neither' only chooses which lights are on.
data_description.color_format: The next step asks for the colour itself. Choose 'none' for a scene that only sets brightness.

data.on_lights_only: Only affect lights that are already on
data.others: Lights this scene does not mention
data.on_unsupported_color: If a light cannot show this colour

data_description.on_lights_only: Adjust the room without lighting it up. Lights that are off stay off.
data_description.others: 'Adaptive' keeps them following the sun, which is usually what you want.
data_description.on_unsupported_color: 'Adaptive' leaves it on its normal white, which reads honestly as 'that bulb cannot do colour'.

user.title: Light switch
user.description: A switch, and the order it cycles through. Two switches in one room can carry different orders, so the one by the oven can reach Cooking first while the one by the door does something else.

data.name: Name
data.is_default: Handle plain on/off of this room's light

data_description.binding_type: 'Watch an entity' is the only option that can tell which switch was pressed, which is what lets two switches in one room cycle differently.
data_description.binding_entity: The entity your switch publishes to. Button devices usually appear as an event entity; others use a sensor or binary sensor.
data_description.is_default: Plain light.turn_on on the room's light is attributed to this switch. Only one switch per room can do this, because Home Assistant cannot say which switch sent it.

data.adaptive_position: Where adaptive sits in the cycle
data.off_at_end: End the cycle by switching off
data.on_foreign_state: If the room is in something not on this list
data.press_states: Values that count as a press
data.double_press_states: Values that count as a double press
data.long_press_states: Values that count as a long press

data_description.on_foreign_state: 'Restart' begins this switch's own list from the top, which lands on adaptive and is usually what you want.
data_description.press_states: Defaults cover most Zigbee and Z-Wave buttons. Add your device's own words if it uses different ones.
data_description.press_attribute: Event entities keep the interesting value in an attribute rather than the state. Leave as event_type unless your device differs.
data_description.coalesce_window_ms: Three quick taps move three places in one go, rather than flashing through the two in between.

user.title: Cross-zone mode
user.description: A mode spans several rooms and has named states an automation moves between -- playing, paused, credits. The next step defines what each room does in each state.

data_description.states: The states your automation will select. 'off' always exists and ends the session.

data.snapshot_on_enter: Remember the rooms when the mode starts
data.deferred_ttl_minutes: Give up on a waiting instruction after

data_description.restore_mode: The default relights only what was on beforehand, at whatever the curve says now.
data_description.deferred_ttl_minutes: A room that never empties -- a stuck sensor, say -- must not leave an instruction armed forever.

missing_scene.title: Better Lighting refers to a scene that no longer exists
missing_scene.description: {holder} refers to {what} that has been deleted. Home Assistant cannot prevent a scene being removed while something still uses it, so the reference is simply skipped -- a switch with a deleted scene in its list quietly has a shorter cycle. Reconfigure the object above to clear this.

missing_zone.title: Better Lighting refers to a room that no longer exists
missing_zone.description: {holder} refers to {what} that has been deleted, so it no longer does anything. Reconfigure or remove it to clear this.

shared_light.title: A light belongs to two Better Lighting rooms
shared_light.description: {light} is listed in both {first} and {second}. A light may belong to only one room -- that is what keeps manual changes, scene control and switch presses unambiguous. Remove it from one of them.
